name: cxr_report_labeling_tool
description: Classify chest radiology report text into CheXbert/CheXpert-compatible observation labels.

runtime.notes: The default backend is a lightweight deterministic CheXbert/CheXpert-compatible rule labeler. It does not require a model checkpoint.

help.summary: Labels an active chest X-ray report text source with CheXbert/CheXpert-compatible observations.

options.name: backend
options.description: Currently supports rules. The output follows the CheXpert label convention.

notes: Use on chest radiology reports or report impressions, not arbitrary clinical notes.
Labels are report-text-derived observations, not new image findings.
Label convention: positive=1, negative=0, uncertain=-1, blank=null.
